# National Search Dog Alliance (NSDA)

> > The Voice of K-9 Search and Rescue - Setting field standards and certification programs for search dog teams across the United States.

The National Search Dog Alliance (NSDA) is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 that establishes professional standards for K-9 search and rescue operations. Led by Board of Directors including Terry Crooks, Zephrin Allen, and Gail Collins, NSDA provides certification programs in human remains detection, area search, wilderness trailing, avalanche rescue, and disaster response for canine handlers nationwide.

## Key Topics

- K-9 Search and Rescue (SAR)
- Search Dog Certification Programs
- Human Remains Detection
- Area Search
- Wilderness Trailing
- Avalanche Rescue
- Disaster Response
- Canine Handler Training
- SAR Dog Field Standards
- Search Dog Evaluations
- K-9 Certification Standards
- Nonprofit SAR Organization
- Search Dog Training Methodologies
